address: R4GX+Q9, Sa-nga Ban, Doi Saket District, Chiang Mai 50220, Thailand

updatesFromCustomers.text:
Loong Muay Thai is one of the best gyms in the ChangMai area! I'd you're looking to focus on working on your technique or just want to chill and learn about Muay Thai this is the place for you!

The coaches are amazing there and very knowledgeable in the sport. The owner Loong and his wife Trinity are extremely helpful and kind. They will make sure you have a comfortable stay while you are there!

In terms of training there are 2 sessions a day one in the morning and one in the afternoon. You can choose to do both if you want to make the most of your time there and really learn as much as possible. Or you can just do one and spend the rest of your day traveling and seeing the local sights. You can do this by renting one of their scooters (100-250 bhat) or if you have your own. They train 6 days a week and have Sunday off.

Next the accommodation, you get an option of an AC room or a Fan room. They come with a mini fridge which is great for snacks and protein drinks. They make sure your rooms are squared away and any issues they deal with quickly. There's also a washing machine but remember to buy washing detergent.

Food here is amazing! It's only 150 bhat a day and it's 2 meals a day. Don't worry as they are huge meals, I am someone who eats a lot and I was worried there wouldn't be enough but it's plenty. The coach cooks after training and it's tasty and authentic Thai food, it's honestly better than most places I've eaten. But if you're not keen on the food you can always go to the shops (12 mins away ) and make your own meals.

That's all, I hope you do attend this gym as it's one of the best!

ownerUpdates.text:
Training at a Muay Thai gym offers more than just learning how to fight—it builds a complete foundation for physical fitness, mental strength, and discipline.

Full-Body Conditioning
Muay Thai is one of the most effective full-body workouts. Every session engages your arms, legs, core, and cardio system through pad work, bag drills, clinching, and conditioning. It improves endurance, strength, flexibility, and coordination all at once.

Fat Loss & Lean Muscle
High-intensity training helps burn a significant amount of calories while building lean muscle. Over time, this leads to better body composition, increased metabolism, and improved overall fitness.

Real Self-Defense Skills
Known as the “Art of Eight Limbs,” Muay Thai teaches practical striking using fists, elbows, knees, and kicks. Training regularly helps you develop timing, balance, and awareness—valuable for real-world self-defense.

Mental Strength & Discipline
Muay Thai pushes you mentally as much as physically. It builds resilience, focus, and consistency. Showing up, pushing through fatigue, and improving technique over time develops strong discipline that carries into daily life.

Stress Relief
Hitting pads and bags is one of the most effective ways to release stress. Training sessions help clear your mind, boost mood, and improve mental well-being.

🥊 Beginner Training Guidelines

Welcome to your Muay Thai journey. If you’re new, don’t worry — everyone starts somewhere. Our beginner program is designed to help you build confidence, technique, and fitness step by step.

1️⃣ What to Expect in Your First Class

Your first session will focus on:

• Basic stance and guard position
• Footwork and balance
• Fundamental punches (jab, cross)
• Basic kicks and knees
• Light conditioning exercises

No sparring is required for beginners. We prioritize safety and proper technique.

2️⃣ What to Bring

• Comfortable workout clothes
• Hand wraps
• Boxing gloves (available for rent if needed)
• Water bottle
• Towel

Avoid wearing jewelry or accessories during training.

3️⃣ Training Tips for Beginners

✔ Focus on technique, not power
✔ Stay relaxed and breathe properly
✔ Listen carefully to coach instructions
✔ Train consistently (2–3 times per week recommended)
✔ Respect your training partners

Progress comes from discipline and repetition.

4️⃣ Safety & Respect

Muay Thai is a combat sport built on respect and discipline.

• Always follow coach instructions
• Keep controlled power during partner drills
• Maintain hygiene (clean gear, trimmed nails)
• Inform coaches of any injuries or medical conditions

Safety is our priority.

5️⃣ Physical Preparation

It’s normal to feel:

• Muscle soreness
• Fatigue
• Coordination challenges

Your body will adapt. Stay consistent and allow proper recovery.

Why Muay Thai Training Is One of the Best Things You Can Do for Your Health 🥊

Muay Thai is more than just a martial art — it’s a complete workout for both body and mind.

Training regularly helps improve cardiovascular health, burn calories efficiently, and build real functional strength. Every session works your entire body through movement, balance, coordination, and endurance training. Unlike ordinary workouts, Muay Thai keeps you active, focused, and constantly improving.

Beyond physical fitness, Muay Thai also reduces stress, increases confidence, and strengthens mental discipline. Many people join for fitness but stay because of the positive energy, supportive community, and strong mindset developed through training.

Whether you are a beginner or experienced athlete, Muay Thai helps you become stronger, healthier, and more confident in everyday life.

Start your journey. Train smart. Feel the difference.

Whether you’re stepping into your first Muay Thai class or shopping for your first pair of gloves, choosing the right pair matters. The best Muay Thai gloves for beginners protect your hands, improve performance, and make training safer and more comfortable. This guide helps you choose wisely — no confusion, no guesswork.
Why Gloves Matter for Beginners

Starting Muay Thai without the right gloves is like driving without a seatbelt — you can, but you shouldn’t.

Proper gloves:
✔ Protect your knuckles and wrists
✔ Reduce risk of injury
✔ Improve wrist alignment
✔ Make training more enjoyable
How to Choose Your First Muay Thai Gloves

Here’s what to look for when picking gloves:

🧠 1. Size & Weight

Muay Thai gloves are measured in ounces (oz) — larger equals more padding.

10–12 oz: Best for lighter athletes & kids

14–16 oz: Best for most adults — ideal for bag work & light sparring

18 oz+: Heavy padding for bigger fighters or intense sparring

➡ For beginners looking for all-round training, 14 oz or 16 oz is usually perfect.
2. Material
Genuine leather: Lasts longer, feels better — worth the investment
Synthetic leather: Budget-friendly and beginner-friendly
3. Wrist Support
Good gloves will have secure Velcro straps or lace-up designs to stabilize your wrist and reduce injury risk.
4. Padding & Protection

Multiple foam layers absorb impac
Thicker palm padding improves comfort
Sparring gloves have more protection than bag-only gloves

This was my first time practicing Muay Thai and I might be addicted now. The way the staff and coaches went out of their way to make me feel comfortable was an absolute joy. The owner of the gym is one of the most personable people I've met in a long time and his energy is reflected in his dynamic staff. Whether you're a skilled professional, looking to stay/get fit, or you just want to learn some self defense measures.... this is the place for you.

While every coach is special and unique there are two who stand out for me. Coach Mike is a young energetic fighter who speaks great english, loves teaching others, is full of jokes, and good energy. His style of teaching made it easy for me to follow and feel confident. Coach Boonlai is a seasoned champion who's love of Muay Thai pours out in every training session. Even though he struggled to communicate in English, his passion for training made his intentions crystal clear and made training a lot of fun.

I'm moving to Chiang Maj and couldn't envision living here without having this gym as a staple in my fitness routine.

During my time here I've seen men and women, young and old, using Muay Thai as a way to relieve stress, heal themselves, boost confidence, shed fat, and make new friends.

If you're considering Muay Thai, this is the place to go!!

Sukhothai Stretch & Align
